column1: # Original function entry -> function of this build, for the differential test (ms1-emu difftest).
# Columns: original entry (hex), function here, return value (v none, b byte in B, w word in D),
# stack argument bytes the test leaves out where the original keeps a parameter in its slot,
# pN: D and N bytes of stack arguments may point to strings in flash (difftest skips a call
# whose string is not at that address in this build: the original's read-only data).
# Interrupt handlers are not listed: an interrupt enters them, not a call.
